graph coupling {
  // Graph attributes
  rankdir=LR;
  splines=ortho;
  nodesep=0.5;
  ranksep=0.5;

  // Default node attributes
  node [
    shape=box
    fontname="Helvetica"
    fontsize=12
  ];

  // Nodes
  "a.go" [
    label="a.go"
    shape="box"
  ];
  "b.go" [
    label="b.go"
    shape="box"
  ];

  // Edges
  "a.go" -- "b.go" [
    label="80% (15)"
  ];
}
